description:
Process-local agent communication and advisory path overlap for *orchestrated* children.

## Background

Shared checkout is the normal environment. Agents need to see who else is live and tap a peer on the shoulder without routing through the parent model. That is not a mail product, not IRC, not durable.

Messaging was specified after the native pass invented wait-for-reply and parked sessions. Those are rejected. Messages only succeed while the recipient run is live. Peer chat may postpone idle; halt if it runs on. No timeout product.

## Why after minions core

Need groups, live child handles, and packet delivery. Do not start this until `orchestrate` exists or you will invent a second session table.

## Out of scope

Broadcast, cross-session mail, wait-for-reply tools, file locks, automatic worktrees, beadwork TUI fleet rows.

## Success

Two live children can message each other without a parent turn. Terminal recipients fail clearly. Parent-directed child messages wake the parent as `parentMessage` (child still running). Path overlap warns and continues.

comments.text: Requires orchestrate + live handles. Spawn children do not get comm tools. No parked sessions, no wait-for-reply.

title: [EPIC] Minion messaging and advisory paths
